title: Booking a short course
instructions: Авторская тренировочная работа Academy AI. Это сокращённая практика, а не официальный IELTS test. Балл IELTS не вычисляется.

content.introduction: Прослушай разговор, затем заполни сведения. Короткие ответы: не более двух слов и/или числа. Можно слушать повторно: это учебный режим.
content.transcript: Receptionist: Hello, Riverside Learning Centre. How can I help? Student: I would like to join the evening photography course. Does it start on Monday? Receptionist: The general course starts on Monday, but the evening group begins on Wednesday, the fourteenth of October. Student: What time should I arrive? Receptionist: The class starts at six thirty in the evening. Please arrive ten minutes early. Student: Is the fee forty pounds? Receptionist: That was last year. It is forty-five pounds now, including a printed guide. Student: Do I need to bring a camera? Receptionist: Yes, bring your own camera. We provide the other equipment. Student: And where is the classroom? Receptionist: Room sixteen, on the first floor. Student: Thank you. I will book that group.

questions.prompt: On which day of the week does the evening group begin?
questions.explanation: Monday относится к другому курсу. Вечерняя группа начинается в среду.

questions.prompt: What time does the class start?
questions.explanation: Приходить просят раньше, но начало в 6:30 вечера.

questions.prompt: Current fee in pounds: write a number.
questions.explanation: £40 — прошлогодняя цена; сейчас £45.

questions.prompt: What should the student bring?
questions.explanation: Свой фотоаппарат обязателен; остальное оборудование предоставляют.

questions.prompt: Room number:
questions.explanation: Кабинет sixteen, не sixty.

title: A community garden briefing
instructions: Авторская тренировочная работа Academy AI. Это сокращённая практика, а не официальный IELTS test. Балл IELTS не вычисляется.

content.introduction: Послушай короткое объявление координатора. Для открытых вопросов используй не более двух слов или число.
content.transcript: Welcome to the Eastfield community garden. Before we begin, let me explain how the project works. The site used to be a car park. The council gave us permission to use it last spring, and local residents built the first beds in April. We meet every Saturday morning, but watering is shared throughout the week. New volunteers should first speak to Helen, our coordinator. You do not need gardening experience. We will provide gloves, but please wear strong shoes. Children can join if an adult stays with them. We grow vegetables for volunteers and donate any extra produce to the neighbourhood kitchen. At first we planned to sell it, but the group preferred sharing. Next month we hope to add a rainwater tank. The tank has not been ordered yet because we are still collecting donations. Today, please help clear the path before we begin planting.

title: A campus bicycle trial
instructions: Авторская тренировочная работа Academy AI. Это сокращённая практика, а не официальный IELTS test. Балл IELTS не вычисляется.

content.introduction: Прочитай авторский текст. Ответь на 6 вопросов. Для True / False / Not Given используй только сведения текста. Таймер ориентировочный; ответ после лимита сохраняется с отметкой.
content.passage:
A. Northbridge College introduced a bicycle lending scheme for one term. Fifty bicycles were available from two staffed collection points. Students could borrow a bicycle for up to four hours after showing their college card. There was no charge, although late returns could lead to a temporary suspension. The scheme was intended to make short trips between teaching buildings easier.

B. During the first month, staff recorded 620 loans. The busiest collection point was near the science building, where the path to the main library was longer than the route from other departments. Staff did not ask borrowers why they chose cycling, so the location alone cannot establish the reason for the difference. Some students commented that the bicycles were particularly useful when they carried books, but these comments were not collected systematically.

C. A survey at the end of the term received 180 responses. Most respondents wanted the scheme to continue. However, the invitation was sent only to students who had borrowed a bicycle at least once. Students who avoided cycling because of safety concerns or disability were therefore not represented. The college acknowledged that the survey could not describe the needs of the entire student population.

D. The maintenance team found that tyre repairs took more time than expected. It recommended a weekly inspection and a small stock of replacement tyres. No serious accidents were reported during the trial, but the number of journeys was too small to draw a broad conclusion about safety. The college decided to continue the scheme for another term while also consulting students who had not used it. It has not decided whether to increase the number of bicycles.

questions.prompt: Maximum loan length, in hours:
questions.explanation: Абзац A: up to four hours.

questions.prompt: Students paid a fee for every bicycle loan.
questions.explanation: В абзаце A: no charge.

questions.prompt: Best heading for paragraph C:
questions.explanation: Опрошены только пользователи; других студентов не включили.
options: Proof that all students prefer cycling

questions.prompt: How many loans were recorded in the first month?
questions.explanation: Абзац B приводит 620 выдач.

questions.prompt: The college proved the scheme was safe for every student.
questions.explanation: Абзац D прямо говорит о недостаточном числе поездок для широкого вывода.

questions.prompt: Each replacement tyre cost £12.
questions.explanation: Стоимость покрышек в тексте отсутствует.

title: Learning through repair
instructions: Авторская тренировочная работа Academy AI. Это сокращённая практика, а не официальный IELTS test. Балл IELTS не вычисляется.

content.introduction: Найди доказательство каждого ответа в тексте. В открытых вопросах используй не более двух слов. Нельзя выводить Not Given из собственных предположений.
content.passage:
A. Repair workshops have become a familiar feature of some public libraries. Visitors bring small household objects and work alongside volunteers to diagnose faults. The aim is not simply to return an object in working order. Organisers also want visitors to understand how it works and recognise when a repair requires professional help. Electrical items are accepted only where a qualified volunteer is present.

B. A regional network followed twelve workshops for six months. Volunteers recorded the type of object, whether it was repaired, and the approximate time spent. Of 480 objects brought in, 288 were repaired during the session. Other objects needed parts that were not immediately available, or had faults beyond the volunteers’ expertise. An unsuccessful repair did not always mean an unsuccessful learning experience: several visitors reported that they now understood why their item had failed.

C. The network’s report estimated the potential reduction in discarded objects, but it did not weigh the items or verify what happened to them after the workshops. Some repaired objects might have been kept anyway. The authors therefore avoided presenting their estimate as a precise measure of waste prevented. They suggested contacting visitors after three months to find out whether the objects were still in use.

D. Recruiting volunteers remained a challenge. Technical expertise was valuable, but organisers also looked for patience and an ability to explain decisions. One volunteer commented that doing a repair alone was often faster than teaching someone to do it. Nevertheless, the network chose to preserve its educational approach. It planned shorter introductory sessions for new volunteers rather than converting the workshops into a free repair service.

questions.prompt: For electrical items, what kind of volunteer must be present?
questions.explanation: Абзац A: a qualified volunteer.

questions.prompt: How many objects were repaired during a session?
questions.explanation: В абзаце B: 288 из 480.

questions.prompt: Every unrepaired item produced no learning benefit.
questions.explanation: Абзац B говорит, что люди могли понять причину поломки.

questions.prompt: The network weighed every item.
questions.explanation: Абзац C: did not weigh the items.

questions.prompt: After how many months did the authors suggest contacting visitors?
questions.explanation: Абзац C предлагает контакт через три месяца.

questions.prompt: Why retain an educational approach even if it takes longer?
questions.answer: Teaching visitors is part of the purpose
questions.explanation: Обучение входит в цель мастерских; это не только бесплатный ремонт.
options: The volunteers are paid by the hour
Teaching visitors is part of the purpose
